mapper.select: SELECT u.id, u.user_id, u.password, u.user_nm, u.email, u.enabled, u.phone_num, u.nickname, u.bank_nm, u.depositor, u.account_number, u.created_at, u.updated_at, u.auth_id, guard_type, full_address, u.phone_hash, memo, (CASE WHEN auth_id = '01' THEN 'ROLE_ADMIN' WHEN auth_id = '02' THEN 'ROLE_USER' WHEN auth_id = '03' THEN 'ROLE_LEADER' ELSE 'X' END) AS auth, f.saved_name FROM user u LEFT OUTER JOIN user_address ua ON u.id = ua.user_id and ua.is_deleted ='N' LEFT OUTER JOIN files f ON u.id = f.target_id AND target_type = 'profile' and f.is_deleted ='N' WHERE u.user_id = #{id}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO user ( user_id, user_nm, email, password, phone_num, phone_hash, referrer_no, auth_id, role, guard_type ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{userNm}, #{email, typeHandler=com.safeg.user.util.CryptoTypeHandler}, #{password}, #{phoneNum, typeHandler=com.safeg.user.util.CryptoTypeHandler}, #{phoneHash}, #{referrerNo}, '02', 'User', '00' )
INSERT INTO user_auth( id, name, auth_cd, auth ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{name}, #{authCd}, #{auth})
mapper.update: UPDATE user set nickname = #{nickname}, email = #{email}, phone_num = #{phoneNum}, bank_nm = #{bankNm}, account_Number = #{accountNumber}, depositor = #{depositor}, updated_at = now() WHERE id= #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE role = 'USER'
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user WHERE guard_type IN('02','03')

SELECT u.user_id, u.user_nm, COALESCE(COUNT(uc.campaign_id), 0) AS count FROM user u LEFT OUTER JOIN user_campaign uc ON u.user_id = uc.user_id AND uc.status in ('2','9') WHERE u.role in ('USER', 'LEADER') AND uc.is_deleted = 'N' AND apply_date LIKE CONCAT('2026-07', '%') GROUP BY u.id, u.user_nm, u.email ORDER BY count DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT 10

SELECT u.id AS user_id, u.user_nm, u.user_id AS id, SUM(amount) AS amount, u.role FROM point_history ph LEFT OUTER JOIN user u ON ph.user_no = u.id AND ph.is_deleted = 'N' LEFT OUTER JOIN campaign c ON ph.campaign_id = c.CAMPAIGN_ID /* 실시간 인원수를 계산하는 서브쿼리 추가 */ -- 서브쿼리 부분 수정 LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT campaign_id, DATE(apply_date) AS work_date, -- 💥 출근한 '날짜'를 추출 COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) AS active_applicants -- 당일 순수 출근 인원수 FROM user_campaign WHERE status = '2' AND is_deleted = 'N' GROUP BY campaign_id, DATE(apply_date) -- 💥 캠페인 번호와 날짜별로 그룹을 묶음 ) uc_count ON ph.campaign_id = uc_count.campaign_id AND ph.mission_date = uc_count.work_date -- 💥 [중요] 포인트 날짜와 출근 날짜가 일치하는 것만 매칭! WHERE u.role IN ('USER', 'LEADER') AND ph.is_deleted = 'N' AND ph.mission_date LIKE CONCAT('2026-07', '%')
GROUP BY u.id, u.user_nm, u.user_id, u.role ORDER BY amount DESC, u.id ASC LIMIT 10
SELECT id FROM user WHERE user_id = #{referrerId}

SELECT me.id AS user_no, me.user_id AS user_id, me.referrer_no AS referrer_no, -- 내가 등록한 추천인 회원번호 ref.user_id AS referrer_id -- 추천인의 아이디! FROM user me LEFT OUTER JOIN user ref ON me.referrer_no = ref.id WHERE me.id = #{userNo};
SELECT IF(COUNT(*) > 0, FALSE, TRUE) AS is_Duplicate FROM user WHERE user_id = #{userId}
